text:
### Investigation  
**Timeline:**
- Incidents <£10k: Investigated within 5 business days
- Incidents £10k–£100k: Investigated within 2 business days
- Incidents >£100k: Immediate escalation to CRO + CEO  
**Investigation Elements:**
- What happened (detailed timeline)
- Root cause analysis
- Lessons learned
- Corrective action
- Prevention measures

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the investigation of fraud incidents across the bank, with tiered response timelines based on incident value and mandatory escalation procedures for high-value cases. Establishes investigation methodology including root cause analysis, lessons learned documentation, and corrective action requirements.
context: Incidents >£100k: Immediate escalation to CRO + CEO
Investigation Elements: What happened (detailed timeline), Root cause analysis, Lessons learned, Corrective action, Prevention measures

raw_entities.name: Fraud Incident Investigation Timeframe for Low-Value Cases
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that fraud incidents valued below £10,000 must be investigated and resolved within 5 business days of detection.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Incident Investigation Timeframe for Medium-Value Cases
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that fraud incidents valued between £10,000 and £100,000 must be investigated and resolved within 2 business days of detection.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Incident Escalation for High-Value Cases
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that fraud incidents exceeding £100,000 must be immediately escalated to the Chief Risk Officer and Chief Executive Officer for urgent attention and decision-making.
context: Incidents >£100k: Immediate escalation to CRO + CEO

raw_entities.name: Detailed Timeline Documentation in Fraud Investigation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that all fraud investigations must document a detailed timeline of events establishing what happened during the incident.

raw_entities.name: Root Cause Analysis in Fraud Investigation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that all fraud investigations must include a comprehensive root cause analysis to identify the underlying factors that enabled the incident.

raw_entities.name: Lessons Learned Documentation in Fraud Investigation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that all fraud investigations must document lessons learned to capture insights and knowledge from the incident for organizational improvement.

raw_entities.name: Corrective Action Implementation in Fraud Investigation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that all fraud investigations must identify and implement corrective actions to address identified deficiencies and prevent recurrence.

raw_entities.name: Prevention Measures Development in Fraud Investigation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that all fraud investigations must establish prevention measures to mitigate the risk of similar incidents occurring in the future.

raw_entities.name: Fraud
raw_entities.description: Financial crime risk involving deceptive or dishonest conduct that results in unauthorized financial loss or gain. This policy addresses fraud incidents across all value ranges and establishes investigation and escalation protocols proportionate to incident severity.
context: Incidents >£100k: Immediate escalation to CRO + CEO

raw_entities.name: Chief Risk Officer
raw_entities.description: Executive role responsible for receiving immediate escalation of high-value fraud incidents (exceeding £100,000) and participating in urgent response and decision-making.
context: Incidents >£100k: Immediate escalation to CRO + CEO

raw_entities.name: Chief Executive Officer
raw_entities.description: Executive role responsible for receiving immediate escalation of high-value fraud incidents (exceeding £100,000) and participating in urgent response and decision-making.
context: Incidents >£100k: Immediate escalation to CRO + CEO

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Process
raw_entities.description: Structured investigation process triggered by detection of fraud incidents, incorporating tiered response timelines, root cause analysis, lessons learned capture, corrective action implementation, and prevention measure development based on incident value.
context: Investigation Elements: What happened (detailed timeline), Root cause analysis, Lessons learned, Corrective action, Prevention measures
